title: feat(plugin-auth): signed-out invitation preview read, an ADR-0138 D2 class-2-shaped door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XG1RRdA5L2gYYiLonDFK6Un)_
Fixes #26020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling-ref: `6413975861` (Q1 → A, Q2 → B), maintainer 「26020 Q1 A Q2 B 26001 A」. Claim `6415981287`.

**Tier H.** The diff touches `docs/adr/0138-*` (a dated note under D2), so this PR stays draft for the maintainer's merge.

## What it does

A person who opens an invitation link while signed out lands on a sign-in page that cannot say who invited them or to what: better-auth's `GET /organization/get-invitation` answers 401 without a session. This adds the one read that page needs, exactly as the ruling scoped it.

**Route (for the `domain:ui` seat that reads it under the parent card):**

```
GET /api/v1/auth/organization/invitation-preview?id=INVITATION_ID
```

| Case | Status | Body |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `pending`, not expired | 200 | `{ "success": true, "data": { "organizationName": "Acme Corp", "inviterName": "Alice Owner", "email": "b***@acme.test" } }` |
| unknown, expired, accepted, rejected or cancelled id; or its organization is gone | 404 | `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND", "message": "Invitation not found. It may have expired, been used, or been withdrawn." } }`, the same bytes for every case |
| more than 10 requests per client address per 60 s | 429 | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, with `Retry-After` |
| a parameter other than `id`, a repeated `id`, or no `id` | 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, located |

- `email` is masked: first character of the local part, a fixed `***`, then the domain. The fixed run does not reveal the local part's length; a value with no usable `@` reads `***`.
- `inviterName` is `null` when the inviter's account no longer exists or carries no name.
- The handler never reads the session, so a signed-in caller (inviter or invitee) gets the identical body.
- Each of the five refused states is decided after the same single read, so neither the body nor the read count tells them apart.
- The rate-limit window counts before anything is parsed or read, in the kernel `cache` service when one is registered (the same lazy resolution the auth rate-limit counters use, ADR-0069 D2), per process otherwise with a one-time warning naming this budget.

## Files

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-preview.ts`: the handler body, `maskInvitedEmail`, the closed query set, the rate-limit constants.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: the raw-app mount ahead of the catch-all, and the lazy counter store wired in `init()`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts`: the row, `source: 'objectstack'`, `disposition: 'public'` (the first row to use that word), `requires: 'organization'`; the conformance pin of the objectstack-mounted set gains it.
- `packages/rest/src/index.ts`: exports `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage`, the pure half of the AGENTS.md route rule 5 recognition rule, so this door answers it with the one implementation (the claim's amendment).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/anonymous-door-sweep.classification.ts`: the route joins class 2's match. Without it the control-plane allowlist would claim it (every `/api/v1/auth/*` route is allowlisted) and the sweep would judge nothing. ADR-0138 criterion 2: the classification follows the amendment (the claim's amendment).
- `docs/adr/0138-…md`: a dated note under D2's table admitting the route as a class-2-shaped door, and a one-line amendment entry in the status block.
- `.changeset/26020-signed-out-invitation-preview.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, `@objectstack/rest` patch.

## Ruling ② premises, measured at `origin/main` `cc378e93ba`

- (a) **Holds.** `auth-route-ledger.ts` has `GET /api/v1/auth/organization/get-invitation` only in `BETTER_AUTH_MOUNTED_SURFACE` (the vendor's authenticated read) and no anonymous invitation read.
- (b) **Holds.** None of D2's six classes admits this read; class 2 is the share-link routes in `plugin-sharing`. One measured correction to the ruling's re-check note: the auth domain does not call `shouldDenyAnonymous` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/auth.ts` names it only in a comment). The whole `/auth` namespace is exempt through `isAuthGateAllowlisted`, so a new raw-app mount there is reachable signed-out by construction. That is why the sweep classification edit is needed. It does not change the ruling's route.
- (c) **Holds.** better-auth 1.7.12 `dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-invites.mjs`, `getInvitation`: the handler's first statement throws `UNAUTHORIZED` when `getSessionFromCtx` finds no session, with no option guarding it. With a session it returns the whole row plus `inviterEmail`, to the invitee only. Pinned in the new suite (the PREMISE leg: 401).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-preview.test.ts` (new) drives the real mount chain: `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` on a real Hono app in front of a real `AuthManager` on the installed better-auth. Invitations are issued, accepted, rejected and cancelled through the vendor's own routes. Pins:
  - the projection, by `toEqual` on the whole body;
  - inviter and invitee signed in get a body `toEqual` the anonymous one;
  - unknown, expired (by date and by status), accepted, rejected and cancelled ids each answer 404 with the identical text, beside a live control on the same staging that answers 200;
  - org gone gives 404; inviter gone gives `inviterName: null`;
  - the limit trips at the 11th request from one address, malformed probes counting; another address keeps its own window; `Retry-After` falls within the window;
  - the closed query set;
  - `maskInvitedEmail` cases.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - deleting the `status !== 'pending'` line reds the uniform not-found leg;
  - unmasking the address reds the projection and inviter-gone legs;
  - disabling the limit reds both rate-limit legs.
- Before the merge of `origin/main`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: 198 files, 3768 passed, 10 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: green, test layer included. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 323 files, 6474 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: green.
- The client suites that read the ledger as source (`client-url-conformance`, `auth-route-ledger-coverage`, `route-ledger-response-schema`): 3 files, 10 passed.
- The sweep classification, read statically with its own `classify`: the new route classifies as door 2, the control `get-invitation` as `outside control-plane-allowlist`, and class 2's expectation accepts the bare probe's 400. The dogfood sweep itself is NOT MEASURED locally (it boots the showcase on a full build); it runs with the `main` battery.

## Gates (local, on head `34e297bde`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the real diff derived 85 families. All 85 were run on this head, each exit code captured before any pipe. All 85 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "85 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `node scripts/check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`: "22 ObjectStack auth mount(s), all accounted for".
- The plugin-auth suite was re-run on this head after the closure rebuild: 198 files, 3779 passed, 10 skipped. Typecheck green. The three client ledger suites: 10 passed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src`, `packages/rest/src/index.ts` and the sweep classification: clean.
- CI runs the full farm; its check-runs are the record.

## Acceptance notes

- The suite imports `createMemoryEngine` from `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`, as `admin-has-permission-endpoint.test.ts` does, rather than minting a new engine double. That re-registers that file's nine cases inside this file's run (about 4 s).
- A caller whose address the server cannot establish (no `trustProxy`, no transport peer) counts in one shared window. That fails closed: such callers can starve each other, but never escape the limit.
- `#25886` remains open for the UI half; Q2 B needs no code.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:新增一个免登录的「邀请预览」只读接口。被邀请人还没登录时，打开邀请链接的页面可以显示「Alice 邀请你加入 Acme」，只给出组织名、邀请人名和打了码的邮箱（如 `b***@acme.test`）。

**为什么改**:按裁定 `6413975861`(Q1 A):被邀请人第一次打开链接只看到通用登录页，不知道是谁邀请、加入哪个组织。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:这是一扇匿名可达的门。收紧措施：只认未过期的待处理邀请；其余五种状态一律同一个 404;每个地址每分钟最多 10 次；邮箱打码；不读会话。ADR-0138 D2 加了一条注记，把它登记为第 2 类形态的门。回滚：撤回本 PR 即可，无数据迁移。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅 ADR-0138 的注记与接口形态；同意则批准并合并(Tier H)。
